title: A notice about visitor maps
passage:
Riverside Neighborhood Map Stand

Our folded map rates how easy it is to hear traffic on each street. It does not rate how easy a street is to cross. A quiet street may still have a wide crossing with no island in the middle. The little island symbol tells you where pedestrians can stop partway across.

Notice a problem with a symbol? Send us a photo of the crossing and the names of both streets. Remember that the dot at each end of a walking line marks a point you can use to join the walk. A dot does not mark the exact place where the route crosses a street.

The colors come from short sample walks. These are made between ten in the morning and four in the afternoon. We don't update the color just because a street was noisier on one visit. We do issue a correction if a building site has made a formerly quiet stretch noisy on several sample walks. Look for a pencil note on the stand until the next batch of maps is printed.
passageZh:
河畔社區地圖架

摺頁地圖標示各條街上有多容易聽到車流聲，不是標示街道有多好過。安靜的街道仍可能有很寬的行人穿越處，而且中間沒有安全島。小小的安全島符號表示行人過到一半可以在哪裡停下。

發現符號有問題嗎？請寄給我們路口照片及兩條街的街名。步行路線兩端的圓點是可加入路線的位置，不是路線實際穿過街道的確切地點。

顏色是根據短程抽樣步行所定。抽樣在上午十點至下午四點之間進行。某一次去發現比較吵，我們不會只為此改顏色。如果工地讓原來安靜的路段在好幾次抽樣時都變吵，就會發布更正。下一批地圖印出前，請留意地圖架上的鉛筆註記。
